steps.name: cat detective (1)
steps.objective: Report the quest to [Parmilla] at “Oscuras Temporary Garrison.”

steps.name: cat detective (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Parmilla] at “Oscuras Temporary Garrison” and report the quest to [Jubil] at “Glaston Central Square”.

lines.text: (A gap in time, the exact time of which is unknown.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ha, I'm so busy today too.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: It's not like anyone asked me to take on a lot of requests from the side, but the leader... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, please call me leader.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Yes, leader… sir.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Okay. How are we supposed to run the mercenary group if we don’t receive the request?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Are you falling far short of your goal?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yeah, it's not enough.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … How much more do we need?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Shouldn't he be the richest person in Sylvaria, Rashur?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I don't think it would be possible to be reborn that many times and work without a day's rest... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's what they say. Now, let's go find the cat.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Is it a real cat this time? Last time, you said it was a cat and it was a princess.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Shiina is a lovely kitten. Now, let’s start with the most urgent request. that's right. It's a cat. meow.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Anonymous. where… .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: “Not long ago, I came home and found that my lovely children were gone. “Mongchi,” a grey-colored cat with a grumpy personality, and “Gamja,” a round, medium-sized dog.”

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: “The two have entered the Nectar Circus and are not coming out. 」

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I remember the Nectar Circus. I was so happy that the boss showed me that performance... .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I've never seen it, but I know it's pretty famous.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, read on.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: “I can’t bring him back on my own, so I’m requesting a mercenary group.”

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The circus must be quite dangerous if you can't bring it in on your own, so you have to rely on a mercenary group.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, hello. Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This time it's about finding a cat, right?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … This time too?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Leader, you’ve also called %s to help you find the cat… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It only happened when there were a lot of requests. %s said it was okay too. Right, %s? Please tell me quickly that it's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Phew, okay… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, anyway, welcome here. Let's solve this together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Potatoes and bunches… . That's a cute name.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Are you going to help me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because I'm free at the moment. By the way, do you know where the Nectar Circus is?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Jubil, who recently visited Glaston, said that he returned to Glaston after completing his continental tour.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Ah, Glaston… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Don't worry too much, it'll be okay. There is also %s.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: In the end, aren’t you planning on leaving everything to %s?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No, we'll all figure this out together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm bringing a cat and a dog. Will it be a big problem?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Phew, it shouldn't be a big deal... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Jubil also has to go to Glaston again this time, so let’s go together. lol.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain, do you really like going to Glaston?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yeah. Many people go together. I'm so excited and excited.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … If so, you're lucky... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No. … Then get ready.

steps.name: cat detective (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Jubil] in “Glaston Central Square” and report the quest to [Romalius] in “Slum Rashuet”.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Should we just drink this and move separately? We're not even free yet. There is the famous Adventurer here, and many eyes are watching. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: After all, he is the hero who saved Eastland from destruction.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not a hero. Other people are much better. But where is Jubil going?

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I have a deal.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Speaking of transactions... .

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I decided to meet Jewel Star, who makes gem encyclopedias. My family has a neglected gem mine, and I'd like to take it there.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: He said that if he found what he wanted there, he would give him this much. It will be of some help to the leader's work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, that's a secret... .

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: We talked about it all in the presence of the members. Too many people know it to be a secret... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe, that's right.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: There are more kids like me on this continent than I thought. I thought about creating a place that would help such children grow up without any problems... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's great.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … It's a good thing, but don't overdo it... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Then I'll go. Everyone, please don’t cry because you miss me.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let's go too. Where did you say it was?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: When I asked the young flower seller, he told me that a circus tent had recently been built on Lashuette Street.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: It's quite large so I think you'll be able to find it quickly.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, let’s go see the circus performance!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I didn’t come here to have fun, but… It'll be okay for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, I’ve never really seen anything like a circus... shall we take a look?)

steps.name: cat detective (4)
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Romalius] in “Slum Rashuet” and enter the “Nectar Circus”. 
2.  After defeating [Potato] and [Hundred] at the “Nectar Circus” and settling the situation, go outside and report the quest to [Romalius].

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I'm nervous because it's my first time doing this kind of part-time job.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Romalius?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s? I didn't expect to see you here... . Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, what is that guy? horn… ? no way… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh girl do you see my horns? I thought the priests of the church had definitely taken care of it.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: %s, who is this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In Invernell... . Ah, how far should I go?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Why are you so worried? Haha, my name is Romalius and I came down from Invernell to work part-time.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: All the way from Invernell to work part-time? Isn't it too far?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, do you see that thing above his head?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Is there really a soul ring on top of your head?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I can't see it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Calone can't see it, other people won't be able to see it either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Romalius, did you come here with permission from the church?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Of course not. With the permission of the village leader and the church, the priests rushed in and cast a spell to make the horns invisible.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I was very moved by how everyone tried to help me become independent. That's why I was able to come this far.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The scenery on the way was so beautiful that I almost got lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What part-time job did you come here to do?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: A priest I've never seen before asked me to find the demon beasts Alexandra and Jennifer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute. Masoo?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Is that demon beast you're talking about here?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The girl seems to treat me like a normal human uncle, and I like it. I feel it. I'll answer you.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Even though I've lost my magic, I can still smell a little bit of the beast's scent. Can you see it over there? It's faint, but I can sense the scent of a demonic beast inside.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Alexandra and Jennifer, what kind of guys are they? Are these things that your older brother raised?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Raise a magical beast?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Even if he has a bad personality, he gives a lot of affection to the demon beasts. We bring in demon beasts that have been abandoned by their owners, take them for a walk four hours a day, and play with them.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wow, this is amazing.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: What on earth am I listening to? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. Calone, listen with one ear and let it go with the other.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Romalius, what are you going to do with that demon beast?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's difficult to subdue it with my own strength right now, and I can't take it away. I'll just check and go back. The client said he would take care of it as long as he confirmed it.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If I had a little more strength, I could have subdued it and received additional hazard pay, but it's a shame.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: But what's going on with you guys?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I received a request. There are cats and dogs that are trapped here and can't get out.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: No, such a sad thing.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Uncle, we're going to see a circus performance while we're here. After finding the cat and dog, of course.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Circus? What is that?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Actors come out and perform tricks, and animals that follow people well come out and dance.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, that's fascinating. Does it cost money to see something like that?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You have to buy a ticket.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I guess I should just do my part-time job and go back.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Uncle, shall we go in together? We were looking for dogs and cats, and you were just checking to see if there was a magician.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let's leave all the dangerous work to %s.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, don't you listen to my opinion?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … … I think it can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Then let’s all go in together.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The inside of the circus performance hall is quite fancy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought the inside of the tent would be this spacious. How do you find dogs and cats in such a large place?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's a bigger concert hall than it looks. It looks like it won't be able to survive even if dozens of demonic beasts run rampant... .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Then shall we look for it by calling its name?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Two people there. fizzle. wait for a sec.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, why?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, come this way.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: There's nothing wrong with that, right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: As expected from Calone. I heard you're quick-witted.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The girl knows something.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I don't know anything else, but I know it's weird. The scenery you see now is thousands or tens of thousands of times that of a typical tent.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Is someone playing a prank?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It feels like a space that someone artificially created. I guess I'll have to change my plans here.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Not %s, but the two people there, aren't their lives precious?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes, it’s precious.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Alexandra!! Jennifer!!
(When Romalius calls out the name of the demon beast in a loud voice, the space where the group is in shakes.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It would be better for you two to leave. In my eyes, these two people look more suitable as a snack for the demonic beast than %s.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: What are you saying with a smile?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Uncle, don't scare Calone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain, let’s go. Money is good, but life comes first.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If Calone says so. Okay, I'm leaving.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s. Let's go forward, just the two of us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My life is precious to me too… ?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's easy to handle dozens of demonic beasts.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehehe. Don't take it out, but take care to find the bundle and potatoes.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Sorry, %s. We will wait outside.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Hmm, two people left, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It seems like it was designed so that once you leave, you can't come back in... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, what should I do with the cat and dog?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Say the names of your cat and dog out loud. hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Try it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then where… . It’s a bunch!! Potatoes!!
(The circus arena immediately shakes much more violently than when the name of the beast is called. Then, an ear-piercing roar erupts.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I think the cat Munch and the dog Potato are the magic beasts Alexandra and Jennifer... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: There is also %s, so you should grab it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you mean to search for it and eradicate it?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Usually, there is a higher bounty for eradicating a monster than for identifying it. Let's take a look at %s duck.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If we don't catch it now, this demon might run outside and run amok. You can't harm the goddess. yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… . all right. Let's go catch it.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Okay. I'll call the kids' names as I go. Then you will be able to find it quickly.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Now this is the only place where the bundle can be found.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The 'bear' that was called a potato, it just looked like an ordinary demon... . Why is it called a demonic beast? Besides, what does a dog mean?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: When you look at me and call me a 'traitor', I see that you are an intelligent and speaking demon. It's not a demonic beast or a dog... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Let's not make it complicated. People like that have to stay here because they pose a threat to people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's true though.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Is it okay if I take care of some of the items that come out after being defeated?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. But what are you going to use it for?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I plan to sell it at a store and use it to help with my household expenses. Now, let's take down the bunch this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You hated it so much when you called that demon ‘potato’ earlier, right?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It has to be that way. Demons born as beastmen absolutely hate being treated like animals. So there are many people who crossed over to the demon world and became demons.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If there was someone who gave such a demon a pet-like name, it must be someone special or stronger than them... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Come to think of it, I also hated the name Jennifer. What's wrong with Jennifer? It suits you well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then if you call the mungchi ‘Alexandra’… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: A bunch! Alexandra! Where are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, wait a minute… .
Boom.
(Something falls with a loud sound in front of %s, who is looking around. When he quietly moves his gaze forward, the steel frame that supported the circus arena is crushed and fallen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tiger Beast….)
How dare you lock me up and give me that name!

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You are a bundle of Alexandra.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: My name is Skara, I am a proud warrior of the Demon World. It's not a cute ball of fur, nor is it beautiful Alexandra!! uh?

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Traitor Romalius? How are you here?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Do you know me?

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: It doesn't make sense if you don't know about the high-ranking demon who murdered the demon world residents and ran away. Crumbling.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: They rushed at me and said they would kill me if I stayed still. So I was just defending myself, so how can that be murder?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: What… . That's it, bunch Alexandra.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Don't call me by that name. Crumbling.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Even so, the character introduction would have said ‘munch’. That's probably what's written in the speech bubble now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: For some reason, I felt like I had to say something like this in this situation. Still, you have more lines than Potato Jennifer.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Potato Jennifer? Are you really talking about Leica? Where is Leica now?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: That guy knocked me down when I came in here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was Romalius who suggested attacking first.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: As expected, it was excellent workmanship as %s is known in the demon world.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: %s? That %s? Crrrrr.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius continued to feed holy water to the fallen potato.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: What could be better than praying for the demons to rest in peace? If you use holy water, you'll be able to get to a good place pretty quickly.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Leica... . How dare you take a Leica… . Crrrrr!

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: By the way, why are you guys here?

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: I have no intention of saying anything to the traitor. If you really want to listen, knock me down and listen. Crrr!!
(As the group makes a loud noise, the inside of the circus performance hall shakes.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: After all, I can't even tell you about the hair clumps or the tips of the hairs... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, stop provoking me.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s, then take care of yourself. I'll be hiding back there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, I understand. The only reason is to listen after defeating it... .

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: This can't be... .
Boom.
(The bundle collapses under %s's blow.)

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Scara, the proud warrior of the Demon World, to this kind of person... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: No wonder you lost. This person is not an ordinary human being. He is a man of the goddess.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Traitor Romalius... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you guys come here from the demon world?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Bundle Alexandra Skara. As promised, tell me why you came here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The name is getting longer...)

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: In order to eliminate all humans and place Etoire under the feet of the demons... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's an obvious story. I don't think it was sent by Barbatos, and it's probably Lux's doing.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: This is not what Lux ordered. To become a corps commander by making merit… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s, what should we do with him? Should I make it like a potato?

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Cluck, cluck… .
(Mungchi vomits blood and tries to hold on, but falls unconscious from the oncoming pain.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I guess I should just leave it like this. Bundle Alexandra Scara will die like this. The person who trapped him probably had no intention of keeping him alive from the beginning.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: As a human, you may not be able to feel it, but this space is filled with the scent of 'cantarella', one of the best poisons in the demon world.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It seems like they were modified to kill only demons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know that?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: In the past, my brother created a large number of cantarellas to ward off those who attacked us.  At that time, I drank it along with the church's holy water to increase my tolerance.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Well, I don't know if I've developed a tolerance, but thanks to that, my magic has disappeared, so I think I'm okay here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad if you don't mind, but what should I do with the request now... ?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: That's right. These are not cats and dogs, nor are they magicians who can receive money... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I can't help it. I have no choice but to go and tell them that the request failed.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Don't worry too much about this space. Because if we leave, we can’t come back in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Don't think too complicated. Then there is no part-time job to do. Now, shall we go out?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Even if I try not to think about it in a complicated way, it still feels uncomfortable….)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Whoa, it's outside. The scent of cantarella is always good. Oh, that's strange. Even when I come out, the smell doesn't go away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, look over there.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Andrea?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: A passing demon… No, I looked at the wrong person.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Did you feed Hellfire? There's also one guy who has separation anxiety.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Of course not. I fed him and took him for a walk, so he should be fine for a few hours.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Andrea, why are you here? Say it right.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I can't help it. I'll tell you now that I've discovered your identity. I just came to catch those who ran away. I will take these guys with me and enter the Lysithea Gate.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Uh, potato Jennifer Laika and bunch Alexandra Skara.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Crrrrr. I told you not to call me that.

lines.speaker: 감자
lines.text: Kuoooo… . Andrea, were you in cahoots with the guys who poured holy water on us and tried to kill us?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, so neither of you are dead. I almost died at the hands of %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: What did you say your name was? Potatoes, bunch? If you don't want to die here, be quiet. A bunch of potatoes!

lines.speaker: 감자
lines.text: Sheesh.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Where does the Gate of Lysithea connect here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way, Pseudaria... ?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Well, that's it. I have no intention of causing a fuss here. Get out of the way.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Just ask one thing. Why is the potato bundle here?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: After listening to the story, it seems that the circus leader here thought these guys were not demons but large animals and lured them into food.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: It's funny that these proud demons fall for such fodder. I'll give you plenty of that kind of food.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Potatoes, no, Laika! Don't fall!

lines.speaker: 감자
lines.text: I will be loyal. Andrea!

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I will judge that after seeing what happens after entering the gate of Lysithea. Still, I think it would be more comfortable than being under Belial.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, you were under Belial? Then you understand. Hey Andrea, do you know the priest who told me to look for Jennifer and Alexandra?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You mean that elf priest? What about the youngest grade 5… .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Lysithea's door was open, so I went to close it, and an elf priest looked inside and made eye contact with me.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: He was talking about my lack of performance and that he would mess up my life if I didn't agree to a deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Priest…?)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: When I told them to attack, they brought a bunch of battle priests. They tried to force the door open and purify the inside, so I had no choice but to comply.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: If I can't protect that place while Lux's restraints are not released... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I gave in.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Sibling fights later, what's the deal?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: … The request is to remove one of the doors inside. One of the doors to the prayer room at the religious temple is broken and needs to be replaced. Do you think these are all the same door?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: And he told me to take care of these guys. They said they took appropriate measures... .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I don't know what kind of person the circus leader is, but he did a good job arresting these guys. That's it. end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if that statement is false?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You can kill me here.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s, I need to send it from here. It's not a lie.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Coincidentally, two people are coming over there too.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: You two are here. What, what is this?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Are these also potatoes and bundles?
(As Potato and Bundle start to get angry at the humans, Andrea extends her hand.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Sit down.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Andrea, no matter what. we are… .

lines.speaker: 감자
lines.text: I will sit down. Andrea! You sit down too. Are you thinking of going under Belial again?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: That's right. Now, here's a snack.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Go now. Don't come again.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I will never see you again. Little brother.
(Andrea pulls out a huge door from somewhere, sets it up in front of the circus, opens the door, and takes the potatoes and the bundle inside.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wow, this is amazing. Is that also part of a circus performance? It disappears as soon as you enter.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I don’t think so. That… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let’s go now too. You also found potatoes and a bunch.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The owner of the potato and the bundle must have cared for them both so much that he gave them such a large sum of money.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Were they really dogs and cats?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I guess they had the same name. A real potato looks like a potato, and a bunch looks like a bunch.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'm already looking for cats and dogs, so I'm so happy that they're giving me that much money.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's good, but... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's nice that the guy there makes a lot of money too, right?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Of course! Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, you know. First of all, let’s coax the guy and eat a lot of delicious food today.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Man, I know some good restaurants in Glaston.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, that's nice to hear.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let me take the lead and talk about something else with %s.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Hey… . I was able to go to a restaurant in Glaston that I had only heard about. A demon from a rural village has risen to prominence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… Is it okay to do this... . Uh, Parmilla?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Labor fee. Is this okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Thank you. Then today is the company dinner! Okay? You can't go anywhere!!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Leader!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe, why? Calone doesn’t like company dinners?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No. If the general manager is good, it must be good. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: A human dinner party... . I'm thrilled.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I’m hungry… . Ha, but somehow I feel like something like this will happen again next time... . It'll be okay, right?
